title: Ascent Koyɗol
intro: Ruuhu potɗo mawnude, kono jarribaama e jarribooji tiiɗɗi, naati e yahdu keewndu. Laawol oo neɗɗo ina maantini e majjere, seertude, e caɗeele ɗe ngonaa nuunɗuɗe, haa arti noon e darnde tiiɗnde e dental luggiɗngal. Mbele aɗa waawi anndude ndeeɗoo limoore teeŋtunde e nder Quraana?
clues: Mi meeɗiino yiɗde ɓurɓe ɓadaade mi, ɗum addani mi seertude no feewi e jibinannde am e galle am.
Mi heɓii yonta caɗeele mawɗe, haa arti noon e yeeyde mi e coggu seeɗa e yahooɓe.
Mi tuumaama ko boni, mi waɗii duuɓi e nder kasoo, kono tan, goonɗinal am ina heddii ina ustoo.
Mi rokkaama mbaawka keertinka ngam firtude gite caɗtuɗe, ɗe nganndu-ɗaa ko ɗe kuutorgal e laawol am feewde e ndimaagu.
Hakkille am e nuunɗal am, haa jooni ina addana mi jogaade darnde mawnde e hoolaare e nder leydi ngoɗndi.
E nder kewuuji keewɗi, mi hawritii e jibinannde am mawnde e banndiraaɓe am caggal nde ngon-mi e ŋoŋɗi juutɗi, mettuɗi.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَبًۭا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ رَأَيْتُهُمْ لِى سَـٰجِدِينَ
verse: [Of these stories mention] when Joseph said to his father, "O my father, indeed I have seen [in a dream] eleven stars and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating to me." (12:4)
